findings.message: 6 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Strategy" above "Freedom to operate is a process, not a r"; "Litigation support" above "What a defensible invalidity search actu"; "Explore all 25 services" above "Search Solutions"; "Why teams switch" above "Most IP reports ask you to take their wo"; "How it works" above "Three steps. findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "CASE 01", "CASE 02", "CASE 03", "CASE 04"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.
Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 6 gradient fill(s): div.fallback-ring.fallback-ring-lens → radial-gradient(at 30% 20%, rgb(129, 228, 236), rgb(19, 124, 141) 25%, rgb(13, 60, 82) 65%) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(to top, rgb(6, 21, 36) 0%, lab(6.18813 -1.61273 -12.3314 / 0.55) 50%, lab(6.18813 -1.61273 -12 | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(to top, rgb(6, 21, 36) 0%, lab(6.18813 -1.61273 -12.3314 / 0.55) 50%, lab(6.18813 -1.61273 -12
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 9 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.fallback-ring.fallback-ring-top → rgb(73, 103, 119) 0px 13px 0px 0px, rgb(17, 45, 62) 0px 16px 0px 0px, rgba(6, 21 | div.fallback-ring.fallback-ring-iris → rgb(73, 103, 119) 0px 13px 0px 0px, rgb(17, 45, 62) 0px 16px 0px 0px, rgba(6, 21 | div.fallback-ring.fallback-ring-lens → rgb(0, 168, 182) 0px 5px 0px 0px, rgba(6, 21, 36, 0.4) 5px 25px 30px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 31 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): section#case-studies.selected-work.scroll-mt-20 1440px | div.mt-5.flex 610px | div.mt-5.flex 406px | div.mt-5.flex 610px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (7 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.
